title: FLORA: An Open Model Suite for Scaling Robotics Data Engines
description:
arXiv:2610.31779v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The life-cycle of robotics foundation models crucially depends on data labels. Outcome reward labels are needed for monitoring real-world deployments. Process reward labels are needed during RL post-training. Timestamped captions are needed for filtering and balancing pretraining data.
